Spacecraft name CAPE-Twiggs (CAPE-Twiggs-CubeSat, Cajun Advanced Picosatellite Experiment)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher not launched
Organisation University of Louisiana at Lafayette
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation US
Oneliner

First prototype of a 3U CubeSat designed to contain and launch tethered SlimSat modules into very low-Earth orbit.
Description

First prototype of a 3U CubeSat designed to contain and launch tethered SlimSat modules into very low-Earth orbit. Having launched successful CubeSat missions in the past, the university’s current project will work with several other schools with little or no experience on the design, build, and operations of their own SlimSat module. CAPE-Twiggs will enhance both STEM education and the ability to conduct regular and collaborative space-based experiments on a larger scale.
